license:
    description: Check for license blocks in source files and lint the moz.build license declarations.
    treeherder:
        symbol: legal(license)
    run:
        mach: >
            commlint -v -l license -f treeherder
            -f json:/builds/worker/mozlint.json
            comm/*
    fetches:
        toolchain:
            - linux64-mozcheck
    optimization:
        skip-unless-mozlint: license.yml
